login.title: Sign in to Polaris
login.passkeyFailed: That passkey did not work. Use your password instead.
login.linkSent: If that account exists, a sign-in link is on its way. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
login.awaitingSetup: New accounts are by invitation. Setting up a new instance? The installer printed the link that creates the administrator; polaris setup prints it again.

sessionNotices.expired: Your session reached its time limit. Sign in again.
sessionNotices.blocked: Sign-in is not allowed from this location.
sessionNotices.denied: That sign-in was denied from another device.
sessionNotices.compromised: That session was tied to another device or network and has been ended. The account owner has been told.
sessionNotices.lockdown: That account is locked down. New sign-ins are refused until its owner lifts it from a device already signed in.

connectionNotices.refused: That account cannot sign in here. Sign in another way, then connect it and allow it under Security.
connectionNotices.unavailable: That way of signing in is turned off here.
connectionNotices.stateError: That sign-in did not start on this page. Try again.
connectionNotices.error: That service could not complete the sign-in.

login.addIntro: Sign in to another account. {name} stays signed in.
login.addFull: This browser already has {max} accounts. Sign one out to add another.
login.chooserOr: Or sign in to another account

qr.title: Sign in from your phone
qr.openFailed: The code could not be opened.
qr.hint: Open Polaris on a device you are already signed in on, scan this from Account > Scan a code, and confirm with your PIN.

error.updatedBody: This tab is still running the build from before the update. Reloading picks up the new one.
error.brokenBody: Reload to try again. If it keeps happening, this is what it failed with.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.sendFailed: Could not send a code. Try another way.
twoFactor.backupInvalid: That backup code is not valid.
twoFactor.usualMethod: Go back to your usual method

totp.label: Authenticator app
totp.description: A code your phone generates on its own, with no network involved.

email.label: Email code
email.description: A code sent to a confirmed address on your account.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp code
whatsapp.description: A code sent to your confirmed number as a WhatsApp message.

enroll.title: Add a second step to signing in
enroll.intro: This Polaris asks every account for one. Your password stays as it is; from now on signing in also asks for a code. You are signed in as {name} ({account}).
enroll.passwordReason: Asked because this changes how you sign in. A passkey does not answer for it.

totp.label: Authenticator app
totp.description: A code the phone generates on its own, with no network involved.

email.label: Email code
email.description: A code sent to the address on the account, which confirms the address as it goes.

email.title: Email code
email.hint: Codes go to {target}. Keep that mailbox reachable - it is how you sign in from now on.

authenticator.title: Authenticator app
authenticator.hint: Any authenticator works - the one built into your phone, or a password manager.
authenticator.startFailed: Could not start setup. Check your password.
authenticator.mismatch: That code did not match. Check the clock on your device and try again.

backup.title: Two-step verification is on
backup.intro: These are your way back into {account} if you lose the thing that gives you codes. Each one works once. This is the only time they are shown.
backup.kept: I have saved these somewhere I can reach without this account.

recover.title: Recover your account
recover.intro: If you have lost your password and every other way in, ask whoever runs this Polaris to let you back on.
recover.questionsIntro: Answer your security questions. They go with the request, so whoever decides it can see you got them right.
recover.noQuestions: There are no security questions on this account, so nothing here can be checked automatically. Whoever runs this Polaris will have to recognize you another way before approving it.
recover.denied: That request was turned down. Speak to whoever runs this Polaris.
recover.expired: That request expired before it was decided.
recover.asked: If that account exists, the administrators have been asked to approve it. Leave this page open - it turns into the password form the moment one of them says yes.
recover.waiting: Waiting for a decision. Nothing here needs doing.
recover.bookmark: If you close this tab, the address of this page is the way back to the request - bookmark it. It expires in 24 hours either way.
recover.approved: Your request was approved. Choosing a password here signs out everything else on the account.
recover.done: Your password is set. Sign in with it to finish.

errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
errors.expired: That request has expired. Start again from the sign-in page.
errors.used: That request has already been used.

setup.title: Set up Polaris
setup.linkHint: The installer printed the link that creates the administrator. To see it again, run this where Polaris is installed:
setup.noToken: No setup token is configured yet. Re-run the installer to generate one.

errors.complete: Setup is already complete. Sign in instead.
errors.noToken: No setup token is configured on the server

invite.codeNoMatch: That code does not match an invite.
invite.title: Accept your invite
invite.joiningAsOrg: Joining as {email} and becoming part of {org}.
invite.name: Your name
invite.oneTimePasswordHint: Whoever invited you sent this separately from the invite itself.

errors.ended: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.body: Your account requires new sign-ins to be approved. Open Polaris on a device you are already signed in on and allow this one.

verifyEmail.verified: {email} is verified {primary, select, yes {and is what you sign in with.} other {on your account.}}
verifyEmail.failedBody: It has already been used, it expired, or the address is no longer on the account. Ask for a new one from your addresses.
